16.madueke_b: By my own self have I sworn, saith the Lord: because thou hast done this thing, and hast not spared thine only begotten son for my sake;

17.s_dismas: I wil bleſſe thee, and I wil multiplie thy ſede as the ſtarres of heauen, and as the ſand that is by the ſea ſhore: thy ſede ſhal poſſeſſe the gates of his enemies,
17.odr_com: I wil blesse thee, and I wil multiplie thy sede as the starres of heauen, and as the sand that is by the sea shore: thy sede shal possesse the gates of his enemies,
17.sabates_a: I will bless thee, and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that is by the sea shore: thy seed shall possess the gates of his enemies,
17.madueke_b: I will bless thee, and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that is by the sea shore: thy seed shall possess the gates of his enemies,

18.s_dismas: and in thy sede shal be blessed al the nations of the earth, becauſe thou haſt obeyed my voice.
18.odr_com: and in thy sede SHAL Be BLeSSeD al the nations of the earth, because thou hast obeyed my voice.
18.sabates_a: and IN Thy Seed Shall be Blessed All The Nations of The Earth, because thou hast obeyed my voice.
18.madueke_b: and IN THY SEED SHALL BE BLESSED ALL THE NATIONS OF THE EARTH, because thou hast obeyed my voice.

19.s_dismas: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Berſabee together, and he dwelt there.
19.odr_com: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Bersabee together, and he dwelt there.
19.sabates_a: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Bersabee together, and he dwelt there.
19.madueke_b: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Bersabee together, and he dwelt there.

20.s_dismas: Theſe things ſo being done, it was told Abraham that Melca alſo had borne children to Nachor his brother,
20.odr_com: These things so being done, it was told Abraham that Melca also had borne children to Nachor his brother,
20.sabates_a: These things so being done, it was told Abraham that Melcha also had born children to Nachor his brother,
20.madueke_b: These things so being done, it was told Abraham that Melcha also had born children to Nachor his brother,

21.s_dismas: Hus the firſt begotten, & Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,
21.odr_com: Hus the firstbegotten, & Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,
21.sabates_a: Hus the first-begotten, and Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,
21.madueke_b: Hus the first-begotten, and Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,

22.s_dismas: and Caſed, and Azau. Pheldas alſo & Iedlaph,
22.odr_com: and Cased, and Azau. Pheldas also & Iedlaph,
22.sabates_a: and Cased, and Azau, Pheldas also and Iedlaph,
22.madueke_b: and Cased, and Azau, Pheldas also and Iedlaph,

23.s_dismas: and Bathuel, of whom was borne Rebecca: theſe eight did Melcha beare, to Nachor Abrahams brother.
23.odr_com: and Bathuel, of whom was borne Rebecca: these eight did Melcha beare, to Nachor Abrahams brother.
23.sabates_a: and Bathuel, of whom was born Rebecca: these eight did Melcha bear to Nachor Abraham's brother.
23.madueke_b: and Bathuel, of whom was born Rebecca: these eight did Melcha bear to Nachor Abraham's brother.

24.s_dismas: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
24.odr_com: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
24.sabates_a: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
24.madueke_b: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.

janvier_by_verse.1: Which things being done, God tempted Abraham, and said to him: Abraham, Abraham. But he answered: Here I am.
janvier_by_verse.2: He said to him: Take thy only begotten son, whom thou lovest, Isaac, and go into the Land of vision: and there thou shalt offer him for an holocaust upon one of the mountains which I will shew thee.
janvier_by_verse.3: Therefore Abraham rising up in the night, saddled his ass: taking with him two young men, and Isaac his son: and when he had cut wood for the holocaust, he went his way to the place which God had commanded him.
janvier_by_verse.4: And the third day, lifting up his eyes, he saw the place a far off:
janvier_by_verse.5: and he said to his young men: Tarry you here with the ass: I and the boy going with speed as far as yonder, after we have adored will return to you.
janvier_by_verse.6: He took also the wood of the holocaust, and laid it upon Isaac his son: and himself carried in his hand fire and a sword. And as they went on together,
janvier_by_verse.7: Isaac said to his father: My father. And he answered: What wilt thou son? Behold, saith he, fire & wood; where is the victim of the holocaust?
janvier_by_verse.8: And Abraham said: God will provide unto himself the victim of the holocaust, my son. They went on therefore together:
janvier_by_verse.9: and they came to the place which God had shewed him, wherein he builded an altar, and laid the wood in order upon it: and when he had bound Isaac his son, he laid him on the altar upon the pile of wood.
janvier_by_verse.10: And he stretched forth his hand, and caught the sword, for to sacrifice his son.
janvier_by_verse.11: And behold an Angel of our Lord from heaven cried, saying: Abraham, Abraham. Who answered: Here I am.
janvier_by_verse.12: And he said to him: Stretch not forth thy hand upon the boy, neither do thou any thing to him: now have I known that thou fearest God, and hast not spared thine only begotten son for my sake.
janvier_by_verse.13: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw behind his back a ram amongst the briers sticking fast by the horns, which he took & offered an holocaust instead of his son.
janvier_by_verse.14: And he called the name of that place, Our Lord seeth. Whereupon even to this day it is said, In the mountain our Lord will see.
janvier_by_verse.15: And the Angel of our Lord called Abraham the second time from heaven, saying:
janvier_by_verse.16: By my own self have I sworn, saith the Lord: because thou hast done this thing, and hast not spared thine only begotten son for my sake;
janvier_by_verse.17: I will bless thee, and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that is by the sea shore: thy seed shall possess the gates of his enemies,
janvier_by_verse.18: and IN Thy Seed Shall be Blessed All The Nations of The Earth, because thou hast obeyed my voice.
janvier_by_verse.19: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Bersabee together, and he dwelt there.
janvier_by_verse.20: These things so being done, it was told Abraham that Melcha also had born children to Nachor his brother,
janvier_by_verse.21: Hus the first-begotten, and Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,
janvier_by_verse.22: and Cased, and Azau, Pheldas also and Iedlaph,
janvier_by_verse.23: and Bathuel, of whom was born Rebecca: these eight did Melcha bear to Nachor Abraham's brother.
janvier_by_verse.24: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
